run_segment_and_lid: run speech segmentation and language identification on audio files using silero_vad and epaca models
build_segment_module: build a StopesModule for audio segmentation using silero_vad.jit model on input shards
build_lid_module: build a StopesModule for language identification using epaca_100 model on segmented audio files
create_duration_batches: create duration-based batches from audio shards using make_duration_batches utility function
get_requirements: get the hardware requirements for the language identification model from the config
